buckets_frozen: Every bin edge in lineage._bin and MIN_BIN=300 are frozen as-is. Changing one is a NEW study.

EPISTEMIC_CORRECTION.statement: MATCHED vs RESIDUAL P&L attribution is ACCOUNTING-METHOD DEPENDENT. TOTAL CASH P&L is authoritative.
EPISTEMIC_CORRECTION.evidence: Average cost and FIFO reconcile to the same +$18,067 total on BTC15m and disagree by $104,913 about the split (avg: +162,257/-144,190; FIFO: +57,344/-39,277).
EPISTEMIC_CORRECTION.forward_rule: Do NOT use the average-cost matched/residual decomposition as causal proof. Preserve BOTH average-cost and FIFO where useful, and never confuse either attribution with venue cashflow.
EPISTEMIC_CORRECTION.what_survives: The lineage findings themselves remain valuable because they characterise ACQUISITION and COMPLEMENT TRAJECTORIES -- time-to-complement, TTE at acquisition, reversals, run position -- rather than resting on the accounting split.
